title: Gas Reduction Firing – Ongoing
source_quote: Salt and Reduction firings — ongoing. I am firing both kilns regularly, as soon as there are enough pots to fill them.
evidence_sentence: The homepage lists ongoing gas reduction firings where potters can bring their bisqued work.
evidence_quote: Gas Reduction Kiln for ^10 reduction firings
summary: Bring bisqued pots (Cone 10 clay only) to fire in the studio's Gas Reduction Kiln; contact the studio to arrange participation in ongoing firings.
how_to_join: Contact the studio at 917-607-4203 or email
